caseName: Canton Co. of Baltimore v. Comptroller of the Treasury, Retail Sales Tax Division
caseNameFull: CANTON CO. OF BALTIMORE v. COMPTROLLER OF THE TREASURY, RETAIL SALES TAX DIVISION, MARYLAND
attorneys: Francis D. Mumaghan, Jr. for appellant., Thomas B. Finan, Attorney General of Maryland, Robert C. Murphy, Deputy Attorney General, and Franklin Goldstein, Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
